test_cases.title: Verify display of patient pressure at the gas outlet port
steps: Navigate to the patient pressure display section.
Input the valid patient pressure data into the controller data field.
Observe the GUI for the display of patient pressure.
test_cases.expected: The GUI displays the patient pressure as specified by the controller data.

test_cases.title: Verify graph refresh rate is at least 20 Hz
steps: Locate the graph refresh rate indicator on the GUI.
Note the refresh rate displayed.
Perform a continuous refresh cycle for at least 5 seconds.
test_cases.expected: The refresh rate is >= 20 Hz.

test_cases.title: Verify graph duration is 30 seconds
steps: Locate the graph duration setting on the GUI.
Set the duration to 30 seconds.
Start the graph.
Observe the graph for 30 seconds to ensure it completes.
test_cases.expected: The graph duration is exactly 30 seconds.

test_cases.title: Verify inspiratory tidal volume range and resolution
steps: Input a range of inspiratory tidal volumes into the GUI.
Adjust the resolution setting to 1mL.
Observe the displayed values to ensure they are within the specified range and resolution.
test_cases.expected: The inspiratory tidal volume is displayed within 0..1000mL with a resolution of 1mL.

test_cases.title: Verify ratio of inspiration to expiration time display
steps: Input the ratio threshold into the GUI.
Observe the GUI for the display of the most recent breath's inspiration to expiration time ratio.
test_cases.expected: The ratio of inspiration to expiration time is displayed within the specified range with a resolution of 0.1 for values under 10 and 1 for values over 10.

test_cases.title: Verify PEEP reading display in increments of 1 cmH2O
steps: Locate the PEEP setting on the GUI.
Input a PEEP value into the GUI.
Observe the GUI for the displayed reading.
test_cases.expected: The GUI displays the PEEP reading in increments of 1 cmH2O.

test_cases.title: Verify volume provided to the patient graph
steps: Locate the volume provided graph on the GUI.
Input a range of volumes into the GUI.
Observe the graph for the display of the provided volume.
test_cases.expected: The GUI displays the volume provided graph for the input range.

test_cases.title: Verify flow rate graph duration and refresh rate
steps: Locate the flow rate graph on the GUI.
Ensure the graph duration is set to 30 seconds.
Observe the graph refresh rate to ensure it is updated at a rate >=20Hz.
test_cases.expected: The flow rate graph has a duration of 30 seconds and a refresh rate of >=20Hz.

test_cases.title: Verify negative test for insufficient refresh rate
steps: Locate the graph refresh rate indicator on the GUI.
Note the refresh rate displayed.
Observe the graph for a duration longer than 30 seconds to confirm it is not updating at a rate >=20Hz.
test_cases.expected: The graph refresh rate is less than 20Hz.

test_cases.title: Verify modal boxes block background interactions
steps: Open a modal box.
Attempt to interact with background elements.
Observe that background interactions are blocked.
test_cases.expected: Background interactions are blocked when a modal box is active.
